MISSION-BASED ENGLISH · A2

🌆 City Quest: Action Mode!

One tense. Five mini-missions. Explore the city, race a car, crack a story, and become a live reporter.

Present Progressive Affirmative + Negative 60 minutes
MISSION 1 · 10 MIN

🔎 Spot the Action

Look closely. Tell your teacher everything you can see happening right now. No numbers, no clues, no correct order!

Level 1: Say 5 affirmative sentences. Level 2: Say 3 negative sentences. Bonus: Find the funniest action!
🟢 Affirmative

Someone is walking.
Two people are talking.

🔴 Negative

He isn't sleeping.
They aren't swimming.

Teacher tip: Ask Martín to point, speak, and elaborate before offering corrections.

MISSION 2 · 8 MIN

⚡ Unlock the Action Formula

🟢 Say what's happening

I am playing.
She is running.
They are dancing.

🔴 Say what's NOT happening

I am not sleeping.
He isn't eating.
We aren't studying.

Magic recipe: subject + am/is/are + verb-ing. For negative sentences, use am not / isn't / aren't + verb-ing.

🎯 Quick Power-Up (6 challenges)

MISSION 3 · 15 MIN

🚗 The Road Race

Choose the correct road to drive the car! 10 roads, 3 mistakes allowed. Press ← / → or A / D, or click a road sign.

Road 1 / 10Mistakes:
Ready to race?

Say the FULL sentence aloud before choosing the road.

The car follows the road you choose, just like in your Road Quiz.
MISSION 4 · 15 MIN

📖 The Missing Backpack Mystery

Read the story and discover what's happening at the park.

Something Strange at the Park

It is Saturday afternoon, and the park is full of people. Mia is riding her bike near the fountain. Two boys are playing basketball. A woman is reading a book under a tree, but her dog isn't sleeping. It is chasing a butterfly.

Suddenly, Mia notices an empty bench. A blue backpack is missing! The owner, Max, is looking behind the bench. His friends aren't playing anymore. They are helping him search.

Then Mia sees something near the snack stand. A small puppy is pulling a blue backpack across the grass! Max isn't shouting. He is laughing. The mystery is solved!

🎭 Act it out: Tell the story in 3 sentences without looking at the text. Use at least one negative sentence.
MISSION 5 · 12 MIN

🎤 Live from Action City!

You're a TV reporter. Describe what's happening in the park. You can use the picture from this new picture again!

Your challenge: Make a 30–45 second news report with 4 affirmative and 2 negative Present Progressive sentences. End with an exciting headline.

Need a starting line? “Hello, everyone! I'm reporting live from Action City. Right now...”

🏆 Mission complete! Tell your teacher one thing you can now say in English that was difficult before.
